Colonnes : une carte se pose sur une car: Columns: a card is placed on a card of a stronger unit and of the other color (a red 7 on a black 8). An empty column only accepts a King.
Familles (en haut à droite) : de l'As au: Families (top right): from Ace to King, in the same suit. When everything is discovered, the game ends on its own.
Glisser les cartes · un clic les envoie: Drag the cards · one click sends them to the best place · click on the pile: draw
Le solitaire classique (Klondike) : rang: Classic solitaire (Klondike): sort the 52 cards into the four foundations from Ace to King by moving them between seven columns, in descending order and alternating colours. Drag cards or click to send them to the best place, draw one or three cards, undo without limit; automatic finish, time, moves and best time kept.
